title: Pupil-facing auto-marking in the companion app
summary: Make the companion app actually mark pupil answers. Pupil enters typed answer, picks an MCQ letter, or writes a short response; the verifier checks correctness deterministically (numeric tolerance via mathsVerifier; short-text via the markScheme synonym bag from PR-13; MCQ via single-correct-letter check; structured multi-mark via method-mark step matching) and surfaces an instant tick / cross + the diagnosed misconception (when metadata.misconceptionLinks has one for this question) + a 'Show hint ladder' disclosure that runs the existing runHintLadder.
motivation: The single most-praised feature across competitor reviews — Dr Frost ('auto-marking worksheets and assessments with instant student feedback') and Liveworksheets ('auto grading and instant feedback'). The infrastructure already exists: hint-ladder, mathsVerifier, markScheme synonym bag (PR-13), misconceptionLinks (FEAT-PB7), companion-share. What is missing is the pupil-facing answer-entry surface and the wiring that runs the verifier on submit.

in: client/src/lib/answerVerifier.ts (new, ~250 LoC) — pure function `verifyAnswer({ section, pupilInput, options }): VerifyResult`
client/src/pages/companion/[token].tsx — <AnswerEntryPanel> per question + result card + hint ladder disclosure
client/src/lib/companion-answer-log.ts (new, ~150 LoC) — per-pupil-per-worksheet localStorage log keyed by companion_token + sectionIndex
shared/aiSchemas.ts — additive: metadata.companionAttempts? to record what questions a pupil attempted (for H1)
Targeted vitest in client/src/lib/__tests__/answerVerifier.test.ts (≥15 cases covering numeric / short-text / MCQ / structured / unknown-format)
out: Server-side persistence of pupil answers (deferred to H1 — Phase H pupil progress dashboard depends on it)
Adaptive next-question selection (deferred to H10 — wrong-answer aggregate)
Handwriting recognition (out of scope of any phase)
Pupil identity / login (companion app remains share-token-keyed)

verifier_modes.format: { answer: number, unit?: string, tolerance?: number }

verifier_modes.engine: no auto-mark; surfaces 'Teacher will mark this' message

acceptance_criteria: Verifier function is pure: verifyAnswer(...) called twice with the same input returns deep-equal output.
Numeric branch accepts `3.14`, `3.140`, `3.14 cm` and (with tolerance=0.01) `3.13`/`3.15` for canonical 3.14 cm.
Short-text branch accepts case-insensitive whitespace-trimmed equality and any synonym from the metadata.markSchemeSynonyms list (PR-13).
Wrong MCQ answer that matches a metadata.misconceptionLinks distractor surfaces the diagnosed misconception text.
Companion-app result card has THREE states only: 'Correct ✓ — N marks', 'Partial ◐ — N marks', 'Try again ✗' — never grey middle ground.
Hint ladder disclosure is collapsed by default; runs runHintLadder lazily on first open.
Pupil's answers persist across page reload via localStorage (`companion_answers_<token>`) so they can resume mid-worksheet.
answerVerifier has zero LLM calls (every verifier branch is deterministic). LLM is reserved for Phase H 'open' essays.

risk_register.risk: Verifier is too strict and rejects spelling-equivalent right answers
risk_register.mitigation: Synonym bag is already extensively populated by PR-13; tests cover the BNF-form tolerance for numbers; short-text uses Levenshtein distance ≤1 for words >6 chars.

risk_register.risk: MCQ schema mismatch — some banks emit 'A' / 'B' as the body, not the letter
risk_register.mitigation: Verifier accepts both `correctLetter: 'A'` and `correctLetter: 0` (index) and reads from the section's MCQ payload format if available.

risk_register.risk: Pupil cheats by reading localStorage and seeing the answer
risk_register.mitigation: Acceptable in v1 — companion is for learning, not summative; answer payload is server-side only and the verifier runs in a Web Worker so the answer literal is not in the client bundle. Move to server-side verify in Phase H if needed.

risk_register.risk: Companion app token gets shared more widely than intended (one pupil's progress overwrites another's)
risk_register.mitigation: localStorage key includes a per-device random ID generated on first open.
